description: Get one job posting by its jobId from search-jobs: the full description as text, locations, work arrangement, employment type, the pay range the posting states, Levels.fyi's estimated total compensation by level for the role (USD; matchesThisPosting marks the level the posting is for), the company, the url of the Levels.fyi job page, and applyUrl to apply on the employer's site. REQUIRED arguments: jobId.
name: get-job
